name: Suzhou Jinfu Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Suzhou Jinfu Technology Co., Ltd. engages in the research and development, manufacture, sale, and service of precision parts of electronic products, liquid crystal display modules, and detection and automation equipment in China and internationally. The company also offers complete machines, consumer electronic components, testing fixtures, lithium battery components, and automotive parts. Its products are used in consumer electronics, automotive, medical, and new energy industries. The company was formerly known as Suzhou Jinfu New Material Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Suzhou Jinfu Technology Co., Ltd. in February 2017.
